note: Codes are the deposit's own column names (data/yoshimura_2026_psych_safety.py melts isu1m9..isu1m14 unchanged). The deposit carries no item text: the S1 Codebook labels them only 'Instrumental support item 9..14'; the paper (Methods 2.3.2) prints one IS example ('He/she provides me with knowledge and information that I can apply to my work') and cites the scale to Komaki & Tanaka 1993 and Komaki 1994 [18,19]. Komaki 1994's Appendix prints the 14-item scale with emotional support items 1-8 and instrumental support (道具的サポート) items 9-14, matching this deposit's es1m1-8 / isu1m9-14 numbering, and its item 9 is the Japanese of the paper's English example. item_text = Komaki's Appendix items 9-14, transcribed by reading a 300-dpi render of PDF page 9 (the text layer is garbled OCR) - a human spot-check of the Japanese is advisable. Yoshimura's administered Japanese is not in the deposit (S1 Dataset .xlsx, S1 Codebook .docx) or supplements (S1 Table .docx, S1 File .pdf), so the wording is the canonical 1994 text; the study administered it about the supervisor and may have adapted stems. Alignment of isu1m<k> to Komaki item k is inferred from that numbering (paper_order). Translation (mixed): item 9 English is the study's own (paper Methods 2.3.2); items 10-14 English machine-translated by this project. option_text is the English 1-5 anchors from the study's S1 Codebook ('Support items': strongly disagree..strongly agree); the administered Japanese anchors are not published, so option_text is English with option_text_translated blank. instructions left blank (none published). Consistent with sibling yoshimura_2026_es_scale (batch_532). Rights: no register row; J-STAGE page shows only '(c) 1994 Japanese Association of Health Psychology' - a bare article copyright notice, no reservation of any right on the scale located, so not a block. Step 3b: no mismatch - table is the supervisor instrumental support scale; dictionary Description 'ISU scale (unlabeled)' could be improved to 'supervisor instrumental support (Komaki 1994), 6 items, 1-5'. Verification PARTIAL: parcels {9,10},{11,12},{13,14} (S1 File) reproduce S1 Table B exactly and uniquely (1 of 90 assignments); order within each pair not established.
